newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore July industrial output up 1.3 pct on yr.
newsitem.headline: Singapore July industrial output up 1.3 pct on yr.

text.p: Singapore's total manufacturing output in July rose by 1.3 percent compared to the same month of the previous year after falling 1.3 per cent in June, the Economic Development Board (EDB) said on Tuesday.
It said in a statement cumulative growth for manufacturing in the first seven months of 1996 was 8.6 percent.
* Total manufacturing output excludes rubber processing.
The key electronics sector grew by 8.3 percent in July compared with a year earlier, but that growth compared to 15.7 percent cumulative growth for the first seven months of 1996.

The EDB statement said the sector saw higher output of disk drives, other computer peripherals and printed circuit board assemblies, while the output of personal computers, consumer electronics, semiconductors and telecommunication equipment remained on a downtrend.
"Compared to the last few months, however, the production trend for electronics was flat," the EDB said -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
